title: Host-to-tenant routing at the edge, with per-tenant redirects and 404
description:
Outcome: A viewer-request CloudFront Function reads the Host header, looks it up in a KeyValueStore (host -> tenant id and settings), and rewrites the URI to /sites/<tenant>/...; an unknown host gets the platform 404. The existing edge logic is kept and made tenant-aware: index rewrites and redirects (amplify/publication/redirect-and-index.js, redirect keys become "<tenant>|<path>"), Markdown negotiation (markdown-content-type.js). The redirect writer (redirect-rules.ts, the "read the KeyValueStore once, write only changed redirects" rule) writes only the tenant's keys. Choice between this and CloudFront's multi-tenant distributions comes from PPY-3b3cc3.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/publication/redirect-and-index.js, redirect-rules.ts, markdown-content-type.js, scripts/test-redirect-and-index-function.mjs, a new shared edge template (infra/shared-edge/), src/papyrus_content/edge_invalidation.py.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/edge-host-routing.feature):
Scenario: Each host shows its own tenant
    Given "alpha.apyr.us" maps to "alpha" and "beta.apyr.us" to "beta"
    When "/" is requested on each host
    Then each returns its own home page

Scenario: A spoofed host cannot read another prefix
    Given a request to alpha's host for "/../beta/about/"
    When the function runs
    Then the response is 404 and no beta object is fetched

Scenario: Redirects belong to one tenant
    Given "alpha" redirects "/old/" to "/new/"
    When "/old/" is requested on beta's host
    Then beta's own 404 or page is served

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-7cd7a2 (the CDN spike's offline part), PPY-99e309. The CDN live half (PPY-2784d2) runs on the staging stack's distribution and must pass before this ships to the shared production stack (D9, 2026-11-13: no sandbox account). Blocks PPY-82de58, PPY-ca247b, PPY-d7c279, PPY-e1d26f, PPY-6b084f, PPY-4a79f9. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-fea16f.

Testing: scripts/test-redirect-and-index-function.mjs extended with host cases; adversarial suite edge cases; a staging distribution.
Rollout: Shared stack only.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a KeyValueStore write error routes a host to the wrong tenant. Mitigation: KVS entries are written only by provisioning and domain workflows with a read-back check, and every page carries a tenant marker that a synthetic check compares with the host every 5 minutes.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
